Container.Name: wealth-tracker
Container.Overview: Personal net worth tracker. Tracks monthly snapshots of accounts, savings, investments, and crypto. Data is stored in a SQLite database persisted at the mapped /data path.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Path where the SQLite database (wealth.db) is stored. Use appdata for persistence across updates.
